story.title: Dozens Killed Amid Ongoing Conflict in Yemen's Taiz Province
story.summary: At least 30 people have reportedly been killed in a recent attack on a market in Taiz province, with conflicting accounts regarding the cause. Houthi rebels attribute the casualties to Saudi airstrikes, while government forces claim the Houthis are responsible for indiscriminate fire. The region has seen intense clashes recently, contributing to a worsening humanitarian crisis.

timeline_highlights.title: Russian Airstrikes on Aid Center in Ukraine Result in 24 to 26 Fatalities
timeline_highlights.summary: Russian airstrikes targeted an aid distribution center and a nearby shelter in southern Ukraine, resulting in at least 24 to 26 deaths, according to various reports. The strikes occurred following the end of a local ceasefire, with officials stating that multiple large bombs were used in the attack. Ukrainian authorities have condemned the incident as a significant setback to peace efforts.

Fatalities reported range from 24 to 26 people.
The attack followed the expiry of a local ceasefire.

timeline_highlights.title: Russian Airstrikes on Ukrainian Aid Center Result in 31 Deaths and Many Missing
timeline_highlights.summary: A Russian bombing raid on a humanitarian aid center in the village of Komyshuvakha, located in southern Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, has resulted in at least 31 fatalities. Emergency teams are searching through the debris, with more than 45 residents reported missing. The attack involved the use of large aerial bombs and is part of a broader wave of strikes across Ukraine, which also targeted power plants and hospitals.
key_facts: Russian bombing resulted in at least 31 fatalities at an aid center in Komyshuvakha.
More than 45 residents are still missing.
The attack involved at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs.

timeline_highlights.title: Casualties Rise After Russian Bombing in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine
timeline_highlights.summary: A Russian bombing of a humanitarian aid site in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region on November 2 has resulted in at least 33 confirmed deaths, with over 50 individuals reported missing. The attack has been described as one of the deadliest in the ongoing conflict, with many survivors suffering severe injuries. Bodycam footage from the scene has emerged, capturing the moments leading up to the strike.

related_stories.title: Jay Rockefeller, Former Governor and Senator, Passes Away at 89
related_stories.summary: Jay Rockefeller, the last member of his family's political dynasty, has died at the age of 89. He served as the governor of West Virginia and was a longtime U.S. senator, known for his advocacy on healthcare, education, and working families' needs. Rockefeller was born into a prominent family and forged a significant political career.

Eisenkot aims to replace long-serving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
